newsitem.title: USA: IMF welcomes Bulgaria moves, hopes for talks soon.
newsitem.headline: IMF welcomes Bulgaria moves, hopes for talks soon.

text.p: The International Monetary Fund on Tuesday welcomed Bulgaria's decision to hold early national elections and voiced hopes for the resumption of loan talks with the financially-strapped country soon.

"The IMF welcomes the agreement among political parties on how to resolve the political situation and hopes that conditions will soon permit resumption of work on a financial program to stabilize the economy," a spokeswoman said.
Bulgaria's ex-communist ruling party caved in to opposition pressure on Tuesday after 30 days of mass protests, agreeing to general elections by April 20.
